_schema: route set for LFM2.5-Encoder-350M-Prompt-Router zero-shot eval. Each lane appears once with three route-string variants; the variant used for a run is picked at the top level, not mixed within a run. | variant_capability_noname: variant_capability with the leading '<name>: ' stripped, so bare-vs-description is not confounded by the name.
_source: lane roster grounded in ~/.config/kaibo/config.toml (live) and docs/casts.md, kaibo repo, 2026-08-05. Model tiers, not full casts (a cast bundles an explorer+synth pair; a router dispatches one request to one tier).

lanes.variant_capability: deepseek: routine coding, refactors, and general text work — the default bulk carrier
lanes.variant_capability_noname: routine coding, refactors, and general text work — the default bulk carrier
lanes.variant_rich: deepseek: the default workhorse for everyday coding, refactors, boilerplate, and general text tasks. Cheap and fast at volume; use it unless the request specifically needs deeper reasoning or a frontier model's judgment.

lanes.variant_capability: haiku: quick interactive checks, including ones that need to look at an image
lanes.variant_capability_noname: quick interactive checks, including ones that need to look at an image
lanes.variant_rich: haiku: a cheap, fast Anthropic model for quick interactive checks and first-pass looks, including tasks that need to view an image. Good for simple lookups and sanity checks; not for deep reasoning.

lanes.variant_capability: sonnet: everyday interactive development work needing solid reasoning
lanes.variant_capability_noname: everyday interactive development work needing solid reasoning
lanes.variant_rich: sonnet: the default Anthropic interactive model for everyday development work — writing code, reviewing diffs, answering technical questions — where solid reasoning is needed but the task isn't unusually hard or high-stakes.

lanes.variant_capability: opus: hard problems needing deep judgment, nuance, or troubleshooting
lanes.variant_capability_noname: hard problems needing deep judgment, nuance, or troubleshooting
lanes.variant_rich: opus: reach for this when a problem resists a straightforward answer — subtle bugs, architectural trade-offs, ambiguous requirements, or anything needing real nuance. Costs more and runs slower than sonnet; use deliberately, not as a default.

lanes.variant_capability: luna: cheap, fast GPT tier for high-volume tool-calling and sweeps
lanes.variant_capability_noname: cheap, fast GPT tier for high-volume tool-calling and sweeps
lanes.variant_rich: luna: OpenAI's cheapest reasoning-capable tier, built for fast tool-calling and exploratory sweeps at volume. Use for triage, quick lookups, and legwork that feeds a bigger model — not for the final answer on anything hard.

lanes.variant_capability: terra: GPT's mid-tier interactive model for general work
lanes.variant_capability_noname: GPT's mid-tier interactive model for general work
lanes.variant_rich: terra: OpenAI's mid tier, meant to answer live — solid reasoning for general development and analysis requests where GPT's style or knowledge is specifically wanted, without paying flagship prices.

lanes.variant_capability: sol: GPT's flagship tier for the hardest, highest-stakes requests
lanes.variant_capability_noname: GPT's flagship tier for the hardest, highest-stakes requests
lanes.variant_rich: sol: OpenAI's flagship, most expensive model. Reserve it for requests that genuinely need frontier-level reasoning — complex multi-step problems, high-stakes decisions — since it burns budget fast and is meant to be reached for deliberately, not by default.
